construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)
candidate_note: LOCKED corpus ×50 (k2 cell 2026-08-19; chips and ledger 2026-09-04); k2_card registers remain an unauthored stub.
sources: REA_03 §4b (interaction seeds — parsed from the doc)

candidates.structural_interaction: Earth pressing Water same-polarity — the dam blocking depth without permission
candidates.k2_overview: Your Earth moves as the General: mass mobilized. Your authority is siege-grade, patient, inevitable, built of logistics and will. You do not charge. You surround, supply, and wait, and what you press eventually yields. People obey your stillness more than others’ shouting. Use that gravity on real fortresses.
candidates.k2_functional: Your order is a fortress code: few gates, hard walls, and zero exceptions after dark.

k2_domain_readings.Pressure: You metabolize pressure into foundation: loads that flatten others become your footing. The watch-point is accumulation. Mountains crack invisibly first, so audit the strain you call normal.
k2_domain_readings.Command: You command through immovability: the standard that does not shift, the decision that stays decided. It builds empires of order. Leave one gate for appeals, or the fortress becomes a wall.
k2_domain_readings.Crisis: In crisis you are the ground itself: unshaken, absorbing, the place others stand. Afterward the ground deserves surveying too. Even bedrock records every earthquake somewhere.

angles.drive: You stay calm under pressure, and it shows. Pressure hands you something solid to hold, and you save your calm for the hard moment ahead of the ordinary day. When a quiet day comes, give it some calm too, because that calm is yours anyway.
angles.cost_self: Whenever pressure comes on, you turn calm. You spend that calm on a crisis ahead of an ordinary week, and the ordinary weeks get skipped. If you keep one stretch clear of crisis, you find that the calm comes with you, the rest with it.
angles.cost_others: Your calm is what you offer first in a crisis. You would rather carry the hard part for someone than watch them shake, and you take it off their hands before their calm gets a chance. Let someone else stay calm beside you for once.

angles.drive: Taking charge is a reflex for you. You would rather own a wrong call than leave one with no owner, and you take charge before anyone asks. If you hand a few calls to someone else, taking charge goes back to being a choice.
angles.cost_self: Whenever a plan stalls, you take charge, wanted or not. Deciding feels like safety to you, more than waiting ever does, and calls that were never yours end up with you. When you turn one down, you keep the evening it would have eaten.
angles.cost_others: For you, looking after a group means taking charge of it. Handing people an answer comes easier to you than waiting while they find one, and the finding is what you take from them. Leave one call open long enough for someone else to make.

angles.drive: Pushing through is how you get to the end of anything hard. You need something to push against, and you finish under strain more easily than at ease. Push on, and notice which jobs you only finish when something pushes back.
angles.cost_self: Under strain, you push through without a second thought. You would sooner push to the far side than ask for less, and you never try the lighter road. Make one job easy on purpose, and keep the strength that pushing costs.
angles.cost_others: Whenever you push through, you carry the people with you at your pace. You would rather hold the pace than slow it for someone, and that costs them the pause you never take. When you match the slowest once, you see what gets done anyway.

angles.drive: Being hard on yourself is the pressure you never question. Before anyone outside can judge you, you have judged yourself, and you would sooner be hard on yourself than hear it from them. You pay for getting there first in sleep you never get back.
angles.cost_self: Once a job is done, you are hard on yourself about the part that fell short. You would rather judge your own work than let anyone else, and the praise never gets in. It is worth remembering that you leave the credit you earned unspent.
angles.cost_others: You stay hard on yourself in front of the people you love. Getting it right comes first, ahead of being easy company, so each kindness you refuse teaches them to keep theirs. You teach them your harshness without ever meaning it for them.

angles.drive: You are never off duty, even when nothing needs guarding. To you standing down is a drop in rank rather than a rest, and quiet weeks get watched like hard ones. You spend the calm you earned standing guard over nothing.
angles.cost_self: Whenever the work ends, you find a reason to stay on duty. You trust being needed more than being free, until a day off turns into a day waiting for a call. You refuse the rest that no one else can take for you.
angles.cost_others: You come home on duty, and your family gets the guard rather than the person. Keeping watch feels more useful than being there, and your attention goes to the next problem. Do not forget that you were wanted off duty more than on it.

angles.drive: You shut people out before they get close enough to press on you. Since your own pressure is plenty, shutting out anyone else's feels like safety rather than loss. Try to remember that shutting out the pressure shuts out the closeness with it.
angles.cost_self: Where help is offered, you shut it out kindly. You want no one pressing on you more than anyone helping, and what was meant for two gets carried by one. You end up paying alone for every hand you turned away.
angles.cost_others: Reaching for you is pressure too, and you shut out the people who try. You would rather be alone than understood, and the door shuts hardest on those closest. You leave them outside with no reason and no way to ask for one.

edge.lead: Earth runs through your career, your health and your growth. It is the hard call that lands on your desk and ends there, the pulse that stays slow while the day falls apart, and the long wait you sit through because you packed for it.
